commitMessage: Bug 407382: [type wizards] NPE on content assist for a new workspace
dslRule:
<!id: add-null-check-before-getOriginalCu>
<!description: Adds a null check for the receiver expression before calling `getOriginalCu()` within a conditional expression, to prevent NullPointerExceptions. This rule applies when the receiver has no side effects and is of the specified type.>
<!severity: WARNING>
$receiver.getOriginalCu() == null :: hasNoSideEffect($receiver) && subtypeOf($receiver, "org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.refactoring.contentassist.CUPositionCompletionProcessor.CompletionContextRequestor")
=> $receiver == null || $receiver.getOriginalCu() == null
;;
summary: Adds a null check for the receiver of the `getOriginalCu()` method call within a conditional expression to prevent NullPointerExceptions, specifically targeting instances of `CUPositionCompletionProcessor.CompletionContextRequestor`.

commitMessage: Bug 407434: [BiDi][templates] Wrong BTD in templates [BiDi 2013]
dslRule:
<!id: jdt.ui.bidi.applyBidiProcessing>
<!description: Apply BiDi processing to Text widgets after adding a modify listener.
This rule ensures bidirectional text processing is enabled on SWT Text widgets
that have a ModifyListener, addressing specific BiDi display issues found in Eclipse UI.
It assumes an Eclipse RCP environment where JFace and SWT libraries are available.>
<!severity: INFO>
<!tags: bidi, ui, eclipse>

$text.addModifyListener($listener) :: instanceof($text, "org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Text")
=>
$text.addModifyListener($listener);
org.eclipse.jface.util.BidiUtils.applyBidiProcessing($text, org.eclipse.jface.util.BidiUtils.BTD_DEFAULT);
;;
summary: Adds `BidiUtils.applyBidiProcessing` call after `Text.addModifyListener` for SWT Text widgets to ensure proper bidirectional text rendering.
